rows.corpus_definition: An academic title given by a university after finishing studies.
rows.example_en: He earned his law degree last year.

rows.corpus_definition: To make something happen later than planned.
rows.example_en: Bad weather will delay our departure time.

rows.corpus_definition: To bring goods or letters to a specific address.
rows.example_en: They deliver the mail every morning.

rows.corpus_definition: The act of bringing things to a person or place.
rows.example_en: The delivery arrived at my door this morning.

rows.corpus_definition: A section of a large organization or business.
rows.example_en: She works in the sales department.

rows.corpus_definition: The act of leaving a place to start a journey.
rows.example_en: Check your ticket for the departure time.

rows.corpus_definition: the act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey
rows.example_en: Our departure was delayed by two hours.

rows.corpus_definition: to move downward from a higher to a lower place
rows.example_en: The hikers began to descend the mountain before sunset.

rows.corpus_definition: The way something looks or is organized.
rows.example_en: I really like the simple design of this phone.

rows.corpus_definition: The place where someone is going to.
rows.example_en: We finally reached our final destination.

rows.corpus_definition: To break something so it cannot be used again.
rows.example_en: The fire will destroy the old house.
